There are only  four oceans and well over 50 bodies of water commonly known as “seas”. So what the heck is up with the commonly referenced “seven seas”, which ones are they? Who chose them? When? And, most importantly: why? Well, me hearties: weigh anchor and climb  the mizzen mast as we set sail on a journey to give you the answer, so we all can feel smugly superior to lesser mortals who use the term seven seas when singing such songs as Sweet Dreams by the Eurythmics, but actually have no clue what they are talking about.
